code.run_whr.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# One real-deployment run under the AUTHENTICATED anchor with the WHOLE-ROW baseline monitor
# (review D1, F-09, 2026-10-04). Derived from run_clo.sh; differences: image hpr-monitor:wholerow
# (monitor.py unchanged + monitor_wholerow.py as entry point), and the host-side verifier is patched to
# the same scheme through a sitecustomize shim (HOMEPROV_WHOLEROW=1). Everything else is run_clo.sh.
# Usage: run_whr.sh TAG ARMS TRIALS PSAGG   e.g.  run_whr.sh e_ps_whr '"PS"' 30 1
# Recipe identical to the e_d_auth / e_c_auth / e_ps_auth wrappers except: the
# monitor image is hpr-monitor:closure (monitor/monitor.py with SCHEME=closure),
# and HOMEPROV_SCHEME=closure is set for the monitor container AND exported for the
# host-side verifier so both commit the same fields. Originals stopped+renamed,
# never removed, restored by the EXIT trap. Never overwrites an existing output.
set -u
TAG=$1; ARMS=$2; TRIALS=$3; PSAGG=${4:-0}
REPO=<artifact-root>
OUT=$REPO/exp/out
SP=<scratch>/hp-whr/$TAG
mkdir -p "$SP"
NET=homeprov-real_hp-real
VCHAIN=hpr-whr-$TAG-chain; VPUB=hpr-whr-$TAG-pub; VSCR=hpr-whr-$TAG-scratch
export HOMEPROV_SCHEME=closure HOMEPROV_WHOLEROW=1
export PYTHONPATH=<scratch>/hp-whr/pyshim
META=$SP/auth_meta.log
: > "$META"
note() { echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) $*" | tee -a "$META"; }

for f in "${TAG}_t_start" "${TAG}_t_end" "${TAG}_report_porch.json" "${TAG}_report_hallway.json" \
         "${TAG}_report_kitchen.json" "${TAG}_other_principal_real.json" "${TAG}_detection.json"; do
  [ -e "$OUT/$f" ] && { echo "REFUSING: $OUT/$f exists"; exit 3; }
done

restore() {
  note "teardown: removing auth containers, restoring originals"
  docker rm -f hpr-anchord hpr-monitor >/dev/null 2>&1
  docker rename hpr-anchord-orig-whr hpr-anchord >/dev/null 2>&1
  docker rename hpr-monitor-orig-whr hpr-monitor >/dev/null 2>&1
  docker start hpr-anchord hpr-monitor >/dev/null 2>&1
  note "restored: $(docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -E '^hpr-(anchord|monitor) ' | tr '\n' ';')"
}

note "tag=$TAG arms=$ARMS trials=$TRIALS psagg=$PSAGG scheme=wholerow"
note "load_before: $(uptime)"
note "git_head: $(git -C $REPO rev-parse HEAD) (monitor.py modified in the working tree; whole-row entry point monitor_wholerow.py)"
note "monitor_py_sha256: $(shasum -a 256 $REPO/monitor/monitor.py | cut -c1-16) monitor_wholerow_py_sha256: $(shasum -a 256 $REPO/monitor/monitor_wholerow.py | cut -c1-16)"
KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
note "key_fingerprint_sha256_16: $(printf '%s' "$KEY" | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16) (key itself not recorded)"

docker stop hpr-monitor hpr-anchord >/dev/null || { echo "stop failed"; exit 4; }
docker rename hpr-anchord hpr-anchord-orig-whr || exit 4
docker rename hpr-monitor hpr-monitor-orig-whr || { docker rename hpr-anchord-orig-whr hpr-anchord; exit 4; }
trap restore EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT TERM HUP

for v in $VCHAIN $VPUB $VSCR; do docker volume create $v >/dev/null; done
docker run -d --name hpr-anchord --network $NET --network-alias anchor \
  -e HOMEPROV_ANCHOR_KEY="$KEY" -v $VCHAIN:/anchor -v $VPUB:/published \
  hpr-anchord:sig >/dev/null || exit 5
docker run -d --name hpr-monitor --network $NET --network-alias monitor \
  -e HOMEPROV_DB=/cfg/home-assistant_v2.db -e HOMEPROV_ANCHOR=http://hpr-anchord:9900/append \
  -e HOMEPROV_PERIOD=5 -e HOMEPROV_SCRATCH=/scratch -e HOMEPROV_ANCHOR_KEY="$KEY" \
  -e HOMEPROV_SCHEME=closure \
  -v homeprov-real_hpr-config:/cfg:ro -v $VSCR:/scratch hpr-monitor:wholerow >/dev/null || exit 5
note "anchor image: $(docker inspect hpr-anchord --format '{{.Config.Image}} {{.Image}}')"
note "monitor image: $(docker inspect hpr-monitor --format '{{.Config.Image}} {{.Image}}')"
sleep 20
PROBE='import urllib.request,json
def post(h):
    r=urllib.request.Request("http://hpr-anchord:9900/append",data=b"{\"sealed\": {}}",method="POST",headers=h)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=5) as x: return x.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return e.code
    except Exception as e: return repr(e)[:80]
print(json.dumps({"untagged":post({"Content-Type":"application/json"}),"forged_tag":post({"Content-Type":"application/json","X-HP-Auth":"0"*64})}))'
note "probe_from_hub: $(docker exec hpr-hass python3 -c "$PROBE")"
sleep 40
note "monitor_log_head: $(docker logs hpr-monitor 2>&1 | head -3 | cut -c1-400 | tr '\n' ' ')"
note "chain_lines_before_run: $(docker exec hpr-anchord sh -c 'wc -l < /anchor/chain.jsonl')"

note "starting runner EC arms=$ARMS x$TRIALS tag=$TAG"
cd $REPO/testbed/real && HPR_EC_ARMS="$ARMS" HPR_EC_TRIALS=$TRIALS HPR_EC_TAG=$TAG \
  EC_SCRATCH=$SP/ec_verify ./run_experiments.sh EC > $SP/run.log 2>&1
note "runner exit: $?"
note "load_after: $(uptime)"
if [ "$PSAGG" = "1" ]; then
  note "running e_ps_detection aggregator"
  cd $REPO && EC_SCRATCH=$SP/ps_verify python3 exp/stages/e_ps_detection.py --tag $TAG > $SP/detection.log 2>&1
  note "aggregator exit: $?"
fi
docker exec hpr-anchord cat /anchor/chain.jsonl > $SP/chain.jsonl 2>/dev/null
docker exec hpr-anchord sh -c 'cat /anchor/refusals.jsonl 2>/dev/null' > $SP/refusals.jsonl
docker logs hpr-monitor > $SP/monitor.log 2>&1
note "chain_lines final: $(wc -l < $SP/chain.jsonl)"
note "chain_schemes: $(python3 -c "import json,collections,sys;print(dict(collections.Counter((json.loads(l).get('payload') or {}).get('scheme','unrecorded') for l in open(sys.argv[1]) if l.strip())))" $SP/chain.jsonl)"
note "done"
code.run_all_whr.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Whole-row baseline (review D1, F-09): the three post-commit detection runs of the closure set, same arms,
# trials and rooms (E-PS, E-D, E-PS-R), each a separate authenticated container swap with a fresh key.
D=<scratch>/hp-whr
LOG=$D/run_all.log
: > $LOG
s() { echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) $*" | tee -a $LOG; }
s "start E-PS";   bash $D/run_whr.sh e_ps_whr  '"PS"' 30 1;        s "E-PS exit $?"
s "start E-D";    bash $D/run_whr.sh e_d_whr   '"PU","PI"' 30 0;  s "E-D exit $?"
s "start E-PS-R"; bash $D/run_whr.sh e_psr_whr '"PSR"' 30 1;      s "E-PS-R exit $?"
s "all done"
code.sitecustomize.py:
# Whole-row baseline shim (review D1, F-09). Runs the interpreter's own
# sitecustomize first, then, only when HOMEPROV_WHOLEROW=1, patches the shipped
# `monitor` module so the host-side verifier recomputes with the whole-row scheme.
import os, sys
_orig = os.path.join(sys.prefix, "lib", "python%d.%d" % sys.version_info[:2], "sitecustomize.py")
if os.path.exists(_orig):
    exec(compile(open(_orig).read(), _orig, "exec"))
if os.environ.get("HOMEPROV_WHOLEROW") == "1":
    sys.path.insert(0, "<artifact-root>/monitor")
    import monitor_wholerow  # noqa: F401
